lines.en: label halloweentwo3:
scene letspartygogogo1
Sana and I make it to the party just as things seem to start picking up, and she quickly seizes the opportunity to slip away from me without saying anything.
Thanks, Sana. I really appreciate that after our long and memorable journey to the Amamiya mansion together.
: Umm...Sensei?
: Oh. You’re still here after all.
Nevermind. Sana is just apparently so short that when I turned around to see if she was still there, I must have looked over her head.
: I’m...gonna go...not hang out with you anymore...
Nevermind again. It appears that Sana has been gone this entire time and that what I heard just now was nothing but a whisper in the wind.
scene letspartygogogo2
: Yo! Sensei! Over here!
: Oh, good. Someone who actually cares about me.
scene letspartygogogo3
: Yo. Figured it was only a matter of time until the token adult showed up.
: Yes, it is I. The token adult. Here to tell everyone to abstain from consuming alcohol and to be sure to check in with their parents every hour.
: Otoha checked in when we got here, so you don’t have to worry about that part at all.
scene letspartygogogo4
: Uh...yeah. But I don’t have to check in again until the party is over, so...lay off for now.
: Will do.
: So...how are things with you two?
: Any noteworthy hiccups in the relationship or obstacles worth mentioning as of late?
scene letspartygogogo5
I manage to discreetly insert myself into their lovelife and attempt to uncover whether Rin’s recent mistakes have been uncovered or not.
And while Rin’s look right now may be screaming, “Why would you ask that?” I’m sure her heart is thanking me for checking in on her in such a mature and inconspicuous manner.
You’re welcome, Rin.
: Things are...pretty great, actually.
scene letspartygogogo6
: It’s not really all that different from how things were beforehand.
: We just see each other more often and...say more cute things, I guess?
: I don’t know. I’m not really good at that part.
: Well...we’re taking it slow, right? There’s no need to get good at any part until you feel good about it!
: I mean...you can say as much cute stuff as you want. That doesn’t bother me.
: It’s the whole “forcing yourself on me and kissing me before I have a chance to breathe” that I want to avoid.
scene letspartygogogo7
: But you look so kissable! Especially in your bloodsoaked dress!
: I want to kiss you right now!
: Don’t mind me. I’m fine with watching.
: For real, though...this has been a lot easier than I expected it to be.
: Not that I thought it would be difficult or anything, it’s just...
scene letspartygogogo8
: Well...Rin is Rin, you know? Making things weird and uncomfortable is what she does best.
: Hahah...hah...
: She’s just been...really chill so far.
: Not really sure what else I can say without turning this into some mushy love fest which, given that you're our teacher, would be a pretty weird situation for all of us.
So, it appears that my probing into [kumon_mi_high]’s newest romantic companionship has been successful in that everyone involved is feeling entirely comfortable and not out of place in any way.
Just kidding, obviously.
I’ve clearly made Rin uncomfortable, but if she’s ever going to get adjusted to lying to the people she cares about, this is something she’ll be forced to handle from time to time.
All things considered, I think she’s doing pretty well.
It’s like Otoha has absolutely no idea that beneath Rin’s costume lies symbol after symbol of a pain so great that not even freshly blossoming love can repair it.
: So, I saw Futaba with Molly, but where’s Nodoka? Isn’t she normally with you two?
scene letspartygogogo9
: Oh, Nodoka’s not coming.
: What? Why?
scene letspartygogogo10
: Beats me. But I feel like you might be able to figure out the answer if you ask this mysterious, yet extremely familiar stranger who just showed up.
: Hah...
scene letspartygogogo11
: Sup, homie.
: Nodoka...why?
: That’s not Nodoka. That’s Rin Rokuhara, everyone’s favorite bisexual barista.
: Dicks are weird. Let’s go listen to My Chemical Romance and play Halo.
: She sounds just like me.
: Interesting costume choice.
scene letspartygogogo12
: I thought it might be entertaining to make Otoha’s life a living hell for a day, so I’ve been trying to trick her into thinking I’m her girlfriend since she woke up.
: You two have completely different colored hair...I’m not going to fall for that.
: As you can tell, my experiment hasn’t exactly yielded the results I was hoping for.
: I will say, though. I feel quite adventurous wearing another girl’s underwear.
scene letspartygogogo13
: You let her borrow your underwear too?...
: Is that bad? I liked her idea and wanted the experience to be as authentic as possible.
: It’s the first time anyone’s ever tried to dress like me. I was just doing what needed to be done.
: Dude...
: That does look surprisingly good on you, Nodoka.
: Doesn’t it?
: Plus, if I lose my virginity while dressed as Rin, it won’t count because I’m not actually Nodoka right now.
scene letspartygogogo14
: That is absolutely not how that works!
: It’s not?
: Sensei, if you’re going to have sex with Nodoka while she’s wearing my clothes, can you make sure you take her underwear off first and not just do that thing where it’s slid to the side?
: I want them back, but not if they have teacher juice all over them.
scene letspartygogogo15
: You’re not getting them back either way! I’m exercising my right as your girlfriend to not let you share underwear with people!
: What?! Can I at least have my pantyhose back?!
: Stop letting my roommate transform into you!
: People keep talking and not giving me the chance to agree to having sex with you.
: Shame. If you’d responded several seconds earlier, I would have actually considered it.
: No you wouldn’t. I’m calling your bluff this time, Rindoka Nagahara.
: Thinking I’m bluffing will just make it more exciting when you don’t realize I’ve stopped.
scene letspartygogogo16
: Okay, you need to leave now. This has gotten too weird and I need to have a talk with these two.
: Are you sure? Because it looks like Nodoka and Rin have formed an alliance and you might need someone on your side.
: I am sure I’ll manage. Bye, now.
: Suit yourself. But don’t come crying to me when you have no idea whose underwear you’re taking off later.
scene black
I leave one of the contenders for “the most sexually charged table at the Halloween party” and make my way over to a small group with a slightly lower combined libido.
scene letspartygogogo17
: What is this? Hath the threads of fate pulled you through the planes of desolation and into the arms of the Prinzessin?
: Yes.
: Hey, Sensei...We were just wondering when you were going to show up.
: I’ve been here for a little while now, but I’ve just been banished from one of the four tables at the party, so...
scene letspartygogogo18
: Already? What is this, GDQ?
: Are you attempting to speedrun the Halloween party, Sir?
: Potentially. Though, I’m not sure if there’s anything I could say that would cause either of you two to get rid of me.
: I’m...sure there are a few things. But that mostly seems right...
scene letspartygogogo19
: Maybe Molly and I just like you more than everyone else here?
: Futaba...you’re not actually flirting with me right now, are you?
: I’m not...not flirting with you?
: Careful, Sir. Legends say that this Adeptus once defeated a giant monster in the Archon War with nothing but her behind. The next monster could very well be you.
: If that’s how I’m meant to go, so be it.
scene letspartygogogo20
: I...don’t have any plans to kill you, Sensei...Let alone in...that way...
I feel slightly disappointed by this news, but ultimately accept that I must continue living for the time being.
: Sir, while you’re here, may I trouble you for some assistance in what I have deemed a rather disappointing matter?
: That depends on what kind of assistance you need and how disappointing the matter is.
: Molly...wants me to drink with her.
: What? Was last year not a big enough sign that drinking at parties might not really be your thing?
scene letspartygogogo21
: Last year was a mistake! I have grown since then!
: Not physically, of course. I appear to have stagnated right near the cusp of lolidom. But mentally, Sir! I am ready to drink once more!
: Well, I’m not going to stop you. But there’s no point in dragging Futaba into it if she doesn’t want to.
: She is my last hope, Sir! The Kendo Princess is allergic to alcohol, Rin hates me, and the girls from your domain never want to partake either!
scene letspartygogogo22
: Rin doesn’t hate you, Molly...she cares about you a lot...
: She just needs a little time to focus on other things right now...It’s nothing personal.
: By royal decree, cease this irrelevant clamor and partake in the festivities of this Hallowed festival before our descent into the Immernachtreich.
: Drink with me so I can feel less lonely and not pressured to go talk to her.
scene letspartygogogo23
: Hah...
Suddenly, I get the feeling that this might be a rather depressing Halloween compared to the last one.
scene letspartygogogo24
: I’ll drink with you, Molly!
Suddenly, that feeling is validated.
: You?
: But we have barely exchanged dialogue with one another. I wouldn’t know the first thing about communicating with you.
: Do you know the first thing about communicating with...anyone?
: Well, that’s what the alcohol is for. We can let that do the talking.
: Have I mentioned how hot you look, by the way? I have no idea what you’re supposed to be, but I love it.
: Oh...umm...thank you?
: Were you just listening in on our conversation or something, Kirin? It’s strange for you to just...jump in like that.
scene letspartygogogo25
: Does it matter? Molly wants to drink. I want to drink. I see no issue with this.
: Besides, I’ve been sneaking stuff out of my parents’ alcohol cabinet since middle[school]. I’ll be fine.
: It’s...not you we’re really worried about...
: Senseiiiii~ Are you really trying to rob me of what could be my only opportunity to see the drunk Molly I heard about at your last Halloween party?
: I’m more or less trying to prevent the arrival of an ambulance in the near future because I know you’ll push her to her limits.
: That’s just the type of person you are.
scene letspartygogogo26
: Is it?
Kirin pushes through Molly and Futaba and presses herself up against me.
And, as much as I’d like to go along with it, there are almost twenty other girls in this room right now who this could start problems with.
: Hey, you haven’t complimented my costume yet. How come?
: I thought you’d like something like this. You know...naughty[school]girl and all that.
: Yes. I was unaware up until this very moment that you could be considered one of those. Well thought out costume, Kirin.
: Hey, here’s an idea~
: How about you...and me...and Molly go get drunk together? Somewhere private.
: It’s a party, right? Doesn’t that sound fun, Sensei?
: If this is how it looks to be a protagonist, I am glad that I’m just a heroine.
scene letspartygogogo27
: Uh-oh.
: Come onnnn~ Why are you being all quiet?
: You know you want to.
: Is it just cause there are other girls around?
: Cause I know a way for us to slip away and really start getting to the good part of-
scene letspartygogogo28
: ...the night.
: Uh-oh.
: Do you think it’s okay to just go around putting your hands on people like that?
: I mean...
: Isn’t that what you’re doing to me right now?...
scene letspartygogogo29
: Funny.
: Now, get off of him. He clearly isn't enjoying it.
: What are you even supposed to be?
: Hotter than you. Now go run along and convince someone who actually wants to be around you to get drunk instead of our teacher.
: Wait, were you listening to our conversation as-
scene letspartygogogo30
: Hey, Sensei! I didn’t even see you there! Haha!
: But...you just-
: Would you mind coming with me for a second? There’s something I have to talk to you about in private.
: Uhh...okay?
scene letspartygogogo31
: Wha-
: What the fuck just happened?
: Chika OP. Please nerf.
scene black
scene letspartygogogo32
: You don’t actually have anything you need to talk about, do you?
: Nope! I just didn’t like watching that little slut put her hands on you.
scene letspartygogogo33
: Like, really though! Who does she think she is dressing up like that? You can straight up see her bra. It’s barely even a costume.
: In her defense, your costume is a little more...revealing.
scene letspartygogogo34
: True. But it’s not like you haven’t already seen me naked, soooo...I see no problem. Do you?
: Not...really.
scene letspartygogogo35
: Oh! You didn’t see Yumi on the way over, did you?
: I know you came with Sana, so I’m not sure if you like, bumped into her on the way and knew if she was coming or not.
: Why not just text her?
: I’ve obviously texted her already if I’m asking you, Sensei. She just didn’t respond and I want to make sure she’s not being a brat again.
: Maybe she’s just...taking longer than normal to change into her costume?
scene letspartygogogo36
: Yeah, I’m sure her “Antisocial [teenage]birthday girl” costume is a lot harder to put on than my...gypsy dancer or whatever this outfit is supposed to be.
: You don’t even know?
scene letspartygogogo37
: Nope. I just saw it at the Halloween store and thought it might make you horny, so I bought it.
: Ahh, yes. A respectable strategy.
: Is it working?
scene letspartygogogo38
: How would you like to find- actually, nevermind. Hold that thought.
: Awwww boo~
: Um...do...do you have a sec?
scene letspartygogogo39
: Yeah. This is the part where everyone comes up to me and says hi, so say your piece now while you still have the screen time.
: Oh. My. God.
: Is that...Niki’s actual...stage outfit from the “Be My Fire” tour?
: Oh...yeah. She let me borrow it for Halloween.
: Niki wore that?
scene letspartygogogo40
: Yes! But only three times before it was discontinued for being too out of line with what her production company wanted her image to be!
: It’s super, super rare! Like, you can’t even find videos of it online anymore because they were all taken down!
: Then...how do you even know about it?
scene letspartygogogo41
: Never underestimate a true fan, Sensei. I know everything about Niki. Everything.
I doubt you know that she’s a virgin who I recently fingered in a hotel room.
But that’s good. Because if you did know that, both of us would likely be dead.
: Uh...sorry to kill the mood and stuff, but is it okay for me to steal Sensei for a minute or two?
scene letspartygogogo42
: Aww! But I just got him!
: It won’t be long...I just have to ask him something.
: Can you not just ask it here?
scene letspartygogogo43
: I’m sorry. It needs to be in private.
: Hah...Do you accept this invitation, Sensei?
: I accept this invitation, Chika. Thank you for becoming my new, unofficial secretary. Please don’t tell Makoto.
: Just...okay. Yeah. Whatever.
: I’ll...let you know if I hear back from Yumi.
scene letspartygogogo44
Chika disappears back into the crowd of party goers, leaving Noriko and me on the outskirts of the room, seemingly unnoticed by everyone else for the time being.
I’m not really sure what this could be about, but she definitely looks a little more serious than normal.
So...whatever the problem is, I hope it’s nothing big.
: Come outside with me for a sec.
: Oh. Sure.
scene black
